text_en: Now Jacob looked up and saw Esau coming, and four hundred men with him. So he divided the children among Leah and Rachel and the two maids.
text_cn: 雅各伯举目，看见厄撒乌带了四百人前来，遂将孩子分别交与肋阿、辣黑耳和两个婢女；

text_en: He put the maids with their children in front, then Leah with her children, and Rachel and Joseph last of all.
text_cn: 将两个婢女和她们的孩子放在最前面，其次是肋阿和她的孩子，最后是辣黑耳和若瑟。

text_en: He himself went on ahead of them, bowing himself to the ground seven times, until he came near his brother.
text_cn: 他自己走在他们前面，七次伏地叩拜，直到来到哥哥前。

text_en: But Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck and kissed him, and they wept.
text_cn: 厄撒乌却向他跑来，抱住他，扑在他颈上吻他，两人都哭了。

text_en: When Esau looked up and saw the women and children, he said, “Who are these with you? ” Jacob said, “The children whom God has graciously given your servant. ”
text_cn: 厄撒乌举目，看见女人和孩子，遂问说：“这些人是你的什么人？”雅各伯答说：“是天主恩赐给你仆人的孩子。”

text_en: Then the maids drew near, they and their children, and bowed down;
text_cn: 于是婢女和她们的孩子前来叩拜了。

text_en: Leah likewise and her children drew near and bowed down; and finally Joseph and Rachel drew near, and they bowed down.
text_cn: 肋阿和她的孩子也前来叩拜了，最后若瑟和辣黑耳才近前来叩拜。

text_en: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company that I met? ” Jacob answered, “To find favor with my lord. ”
text_cn: 厄撒乌又问说：“我所见的这一大队，有什么意思？”雅各伯答说：“这是蒙我主悦纳的。”

text_en: But Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; keep what you have for yourself. ”
text_cn: 厄撒乌说：“我的兄弟，我已够富足了；你的，你留下吧！”

text_en: Jacob said, “No, please; if I find favor with you, then accept my present from my hand; for truly to see your face is like seeing the face of God—since you have received me with such favor.
text_cn: 雅各伯说：“请不要这样！我若真蒙你悦纳，请你收下我手中的礼物；因为我见了你的面，就如见了天主的面；你实在仁厚接待了我。

text_en: Please accept my gift that is brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have everything I want. ” So he urged him, and he took it.
text_cn: 请你收下我献给你的礼品；因为天主厚待了我，我什么都有了。”由于雅各伯极力恳请，他才收下了。

text_en: Then Esau said, “Let us journey on our way, and I will go alongside you. ”
text_cn: 厄撒乌说：“我们起程前行，我愿与你同行。”

text_en: But Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are frail and that the flocks and herds, which are nursing, are a care to me; and if they are overdriven for one day, all the flocks will die.
text_cn: 雅各伯对他说：“我主知道，孩子尚幼小，我还要照顾尚在哺乳的牛羊，若一天只顾催赶，全群牲畜都要死尽。

text_en: Let my lord pass on ahead of his servant, and I will lead on slowly, according to the pace of the cattle that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord in Seir. ”
text_cn: 还是请我主在你仆人前先行；我要照我前面的牲畜和孩子们的脚步，慢慢前行；直至达到色依尔我主那里。”

text_en: So Esau said, “Let me leave with you some of the people who are with me. ” But he said, “Why should my lord be so kind to me? ”
text_cn: 厄撒乌说：“让我留下几个跟我的人陪着你。”雅各伯说：“只要我能蒙我主悦纳，又何必如此！”

text_en: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.
text_cn: 厄撒乌就在当天回了色依尔。

text_en: But Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built himself a house, and made booths for his cattle; therefore the place is called Succoth.
text_cn: 雅各伯却动身往稣苛特去了，在那里为自己盖了一座房屋，为牲畜搭了些棚子；为此给那地起名叫“稣苛特”。

text_en: Jacob came safely to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, on his way from Paddan-aram; and he camped before the city.
text_cn: 雅各伯由帕丹阿兰回来，平安来到客纳罕地的舍根城， 在城的对面支搭了帐幕。

text_en: And from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, he bought for one hundred pieces of money the plot of land on which he had pitched his tent.
text_cn: 他支搭帐幕的那块地，是由舍根的父亲哈摩尔的儿子们手里，用一百块银钱买来的。

text_en: There he erected an altar and called it El-Elohe-Israel.
text_cn: 雅各伯在那里建立了一座祭坛，称它为：“大能者以色列的天主”。
